title: Days Away After a Declined or Lapsed Bed Hold in a Reconciled Estimate Month
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, days the resident spent away with no bed held, after a bed hold under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations was declined or ran out, are taken out of a reconciled estimate month and carry no cost.

**Clause.** Days of a reconciled estimate month away after a bed was declined or ran out: where the resident's latest reservation in status declined, by leave start, and the resident's latest reservation that ended because the payer's reserved days were used with no private extension, by end date, both fall in part inside the month, the days of the month from the declined leave's start up to the day before its return and the days after that other reservation's last held day up to the day before its return are both taken out; where only that declined leave does, the days from its leave start up to the day before its return (to the month's end where the resident has not come back); where only that other reservation does, the days after its last held day up to the day before its return; otherwise none. Where the resident has not come back, a span runs to the month's end. Where two records share the latest date, the one posted first is read.

**Branch table.** "Falls in part inside the month" means at least one day of the span lies in the month.

| Latest declined reservation's span in the month | Latest ran-out reservation's span in the month | Days taken out |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | both spans' days in the month |
| yes | no | the declined span's days in the month |
| no | yes | the ran-out span's days in the month |
| no | no | none |

**Hypothetical spans** (30-day month): a declined reservation with leave start on day 3 and return on day 9 contributes days 3 to 8, 6 days; a reservation that ran out with last held day on day 20 and no return contributes days 21 to 30, 10 days. Both in the month: 16 days are taken out.
